captions.detailed: A compact camera flash accessory featuring a matte black body, a low-profile shoe mount, and a rectangular bounce head. The main body includes a small rectangular screen and a single red button on its front face, with a distinct battery door panel attached to the side. The rectangular flash head is mounted on a dual-axis hinge system, allowing it to swivel horizontally relative to the body and tilt vertically within its side support brackets.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a compact camera flash accessory. The assembly must include a main vertical body with a shoe mount base, a side-mounted battery door, a swiveling mounting bracket, and a rectangular tilting flash head with a front diffuser screen and a red button on the body.
captions.factory: Construct the model using multiple parts. Create the base shoe mount using thin boxes. Build the main body from a vertical box, adding a small red box for the button and a dark grey inset box for the screen. Model the battery door as a separate thin box offset to the side. Construct the swivel bracket using a cylinder base and two vertical bracket arm boxes. Finally, model the flash head as a box with a white front diffuser panel, and assemble everything with revolute joints for the horizontal swivel and vertical tilt axes.
